questions.prompt: What's the term for a network run by one organization with one routing policy? (two words)
Which protocol is used between autonomous systems?
Routers inside an AS running OSPF know about every router on the Internet.
What's the main goal of inter-domain routing?
options: Policy: which networks are willing to carry whose traffic

questions.prompt: A university switches its internal routing from RIP to OSPF. Who else has to change anything?
What's another name for an intra-domain routing protocol? (an acronym)
Inter-domain routing is harder to secure than intra-domain routing because the neighbors belong to different organizations.
Which is NOT a reason routing is split into intra- and inter-domain?
options: Scale: each AS hides its internal detail
It lets every router run Dijkstra on the whole Internet
Independence: each AS picks its own internal protocol
Policy: business relationships are handled at the border
